overall: The AG found no violation: three Board members attending the Committee's open session did not deliberate, and two members in executive session were a subquorum, so no Board meeting requiring notice occurred.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to post notice when a quorum attended and participated in a Community Preservation Committee meeting in open session.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board did not deliberate and therefore did not hold a meeting that was subject to the Open Meeting Law

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to post notice when Board members met with the Committee in executive session on the same date.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, because only two members of the Board, a subquorum, attended and participated in the executive session, the Board did not hold a meeting requiring compliance with the Open Meeting Law and thus the Board did not violate the law by failing to post notice.
